description: This file defines structures, enumerations, and functions for locating and verifying the runtime environment for an application, specifically focusing on the Node.js runtime. It includes methods for version parsing, runtime resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the Node.js runtime by searching for its executable, reading its version, and validating it against the minimum required version.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of runtime resolution errors.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches specified paths for an executable with the given name.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Executes the binary with '--version' to read its version string.
